snippets.title: Disk cleanup: report usage
snippets.description: Shows usage for CLEANUP_MOUNT and the largest directories under /var.
snippets.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Report disk usage and stop early if the box is already healthy.
set -euo pipefail
MOUNT="{{CLEANUP_MOUNT:/}}"
THRESHOLD="{{CLEANUP_THRESHOLD_PCT:80}}"
used="$(df -P "$MOUNT" | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%", "", $5); print $5}')"
echo "$(hostname): $MOUNT is ${used}% full (threshold ${THRESHOLD}%)"
df -h "$MOUNT"
echo "Largest directories under /var:"
du -xh --max-depth=1 /var 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -n 10

variables.name: CLEANUP_MOUNT
variables.description: Mount point to check, e.g. / or /var

variables.name: CLEANUP_THRESHOLD_PCT
variables.description: Warn when usage is at or above this percentage

snippets.title: Disk cleanup: trim logs
snippets.description: Vacuums the journal and deletes rotated logs older than LOG_RETENTION_DAYS.
snippets.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Trim the systemd journal and old rotated logs.
set -euo pipefail
KEEP_DAYS="{{LOG_RETENTION_DAYS:14}}"
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  journalctl --vacuum-time="${KEEP_DAYS}d"
fi
find /var/log -type f \( -name '*.gz' -o -name '*.[0-9]' -o -name '*.old' \) -mtime +"$KEEP_DAYS" -print -delete
echo "Old logs older than ${KEEP_DAYS} days removed."

variables.name: LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Keep journal and rotated logs for this many days

snippets.title: Disk cleanup: package caches
snippets.description: Autoremove and clean for apt, dnf or yum.
snippets.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Clear package caches and unused packages (apt, dnf or yum).
set -euo pipefail
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  apt-get -y autoremove --purge
  apt-get -y clean
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf -y autoremove
  dnf clean all
elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  yum -y autoremove
  yum clean all
else
  echo "No supported package manager found, skipping."
fi

snippets.title: Disk cleanup: docker prune
snippets.description: Prunes Docker data older than DOCKER_PRUNE_HOURS when CLEANUP_DOCKER is yes.
snippets.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Prune stopped containers, dangling images and build cache older than the cut-off.
set -euo pipefail
ENABLED="{{CLEANUP_DOCKER:yes}}"
if [ "$ENABLED" != "yes" ]; then
  echo "Docker cleanup turned off (CLEANUP_DOCKER), skipping."
  exit 0
fi
if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Docker is not installed, skipping."
  exit 0
fi
HOURS="{{DOCKER_PRUNE_HOURS:168}}"
docker system prune -f --filter "until=${HOURS}h"

variables.name: DOCKER_PRUNE_HOURS
variables.description: Only prune Docker data older than this many hours

snippets.title: Disk cleanup: verify
snippets.description: Exits 1 if the mount is still above CLEANUP_THRESHOLD_PCT, which fails the run.
snippets.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fail the run (and alert) if the disk is still above the threshold.
set -euo pipefail
MOUNT="{{CLEANUP_MOUNT:/}}"
THRESHOLD="{{CLEANUP_THRESHOLD_PCT:80}}"
used="$(df -P "$MOUNT" | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%", "", $5); print $5}')"
echo "$(hostname): $MOUNT is now ${used}% full"
if [ "$used" -ge "$THRESHOLD" ]; then
  echo "Still above ${THRESHOLD}%. Needs a person to look." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ -f /var/run/reboot-required ]; then
  echo "Note: this machine is waiting for a reboot (/var/run/reboot-required)."
fi

variables.name: CLEANUP_MOUNT
variables.description: Mount point to check, e.g. / or /var

variables.name: CLEANUP_THRESHOLD_PCT
variables.description: Warn when usage is at or above this percentage
